intro: Most of what I know about getting things done with other people, I learned outside the classroom.

roles.detail: Helped coordinate a 120-member executive board through 20+ programmes in one term, and managed partnerships with companies, universities and government agencies. Previously General Secretary of Administration II (2024).
Led a multi-channel promotion strategy with 20+ media partners, tailoring the message for high-school students, university students and the public; the event reached 2,000+ participants.
Prepared 15+ funding proposals under a tight budget and co-planned 10+ member-development and community-service programmes.
Led 30 students from Bengkulu across ITS departments and ran routine programmes to build cooperation among members.
Treasurer, Keluarga Muslim Informatika (2024). Tim Kawal Gemastik ITS (2025), supporting ITS teams at the national ICT competition.

speaking: Master of Ceremony, IDSECCONF 2024 (Indonesia's annual IT security conference): workshop, keynote and panel sessions.
Speaker, Basic Media Schooling: journalism training for students across departments.
Speaker on project and team management, Bluecamp, Informatics ITS.
